page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with a centred section heading ("SECT. VI.") between two paragraphs. Running head at top left, page number at top right, gathering signature and catchword at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: gio locus esse posse videatur, Iesuitæ tamen & sacrificuli, dum sibi quidlibet animo reservandi libertatem reservant, magna vultus constantia præstare non verentur. Ipsissimam enim illam clausulam, quà verbis conceptis spondent se omnia antedicta fideliter observaturos juxta tenorem verborum à se prolatorum, & juxta eorum verborum apertum & naturalem sensum & sententiam, sine ulla æquivocatione, aut mentali reservatione; intelligunt interim cum alia reservatione, sc. quam tibi dicam.
main_text.head: SECT. VI.
main_text.p: Habent tamen paratam sibi hanc defensionem, quò se a perjurio liberent: nempe ex oratione verbali & mentali unam confici integram orationem compositam, in quà totâ conjunctim acceptâ nulla fit falsitas. Ut exempli gratia, si sacrificulus verbis prolatis juret se non esse sacrificulum; adjectione illa in animo reservatâ, sed non enunciata, Ut tibi dicam: oratio hæc tota, inquiunt, ex verbali & mentali composita, si integre sumatur, erit vera; sc. Non sum sacrificulus ut tibi dicam. Nec videtur ratio aliqua

page.notes: Long s was rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "Iesuitæ", "sacrificuli", "sc." for printed "fc."). The running head reads "Præleƈtio" with a ct ligature, rendered as "Prælectio". Printed "Iefuitæ" and "fententiam" were corrected only for long s. The printed "Ut" and "tibi dicam" are italic as in the scan. The "&" is written as & to keep the XML valid. The printed "Præleƈtio" ligature and the reading of "à" in "à se prolatorum" are the only doubtful points, and both are clear enough to copy.
